items.note: A slanted stroke plus a backwards c — like "lc" written right-to-left.
A backwards c sitting on a base line that sticks out — a rounded print ב.
A small hook with a tail — like a backwards S or ζ.
Like the number 3 with a flat top — careful not to mix it up with צ.
Like ד, with a separate short stroke underneath on the left.
A short slanted stroke.
A small zig-zag, like a 5 or ʒ.
Like a rounded n — close to the print shape.
A C (opening to the right) with a curl at the top.
A tiny apostrophe high on the line.
A backwards C.
A curl at the top and a long stroke dropping below the line.
A tall loop rising high above the line — like a cursive ℓ.
Like a handwritten N.
A closed loop — like a small o.
A small hook curving left at the bottom — like a backwards J.
A long straight stroke going below the line (longer than ו).
A simple circle, like O.
A loop at the bottom with two strokes — like a backwards δ.
A backwards C with a curl inside — like a rounded print פ.
A tall curl with a long stroke — the final form of פ.
Like the number 3.
A curl with a long tail — the final form of צ.
A hook at the top with a long stroke below the line — like a backwards p.

A cup shape — like a backwards e.
